Abstract 
We present Bill2d, a modern and efficient C++ package for classical simulations of two-dimensional Hamiltonian systems. Bill2d can be used for various billiard and diffusion problems with one or more charged particles with interactions, different external potentials, an external magnetic field, periodic and open boundaries, etc. The software package can also calculate many key quantities in complex systems such as Poincaré sections, survival probabilities, and diffusion coefficients. Nature of problem 
Numerical propagation of classical two-dimensional single and many-body systems, possibly in a magnetic field, and calculation of relevant quantities such as Poincaré sections, survival probabilities, diffusion co-efficients, etc.
